verdict.rationale: SumUp exposes a general API, JS SDK, MCP server, and Agent Toolkit that let an agent programmatically create checkouts, process refunds, and receive webhook status notifications, which are the building blocks an AI agent could use to interact with SumUp data (sumup-docs-11,12,15,25,26,37). However, none of the evidence documents a dedicated transactions-history or payouts-listing API endpoint, nor any reconciliation/ledger-export feature — the pack only shows checkout creation, refunds, and status webhooks, not pulling settled payout batches for daily reconciliation. missing for 10: documented transactions/payouts list API, reconciliation report/export endpoint, and any hands-on example of an agent reconciling daily takings.
